title: Navbar UI Upgrade — Elevated Chrome + Avatar Profile Trigger

items.title: Brand wordmark
steps: Observe the top-left brand in the header
items.expected: Brand reads “SocMed” (not “SocMed application”), links to /, typography feels intentional (weight/spacing), no layout overflow.

items.title: Center pill cluster active state
steps: On home, note Home icon active styling in center cluster
items.expected: Home and Friends sit on a muted pill track; active route shows elevated pill + foreground emphasis; inactive icons remain muted; routes unchanged.
items.evidence: User reviewed center cluster polish in session; follow-up CSS pass applied

items.title: Message and notification badges
items.precondition: Signed in with unread messages and/or notifications (or seed test data)
steps: Observe Messages and Notifications icons in the header
Open messages and read unread thread
Return to feed and confirm badge updates
items.expected: Badges show correct counts (cap 9+); styling is compact and readable; polling/socket behavior unchanged from before upgrade.
items.evidence: Badge markup + AppShell polling/socket effects unchanged; compact .app-navbar-badge styling
items.notes: End-to-end count refresh not re-run this session

items.title: Avatar profile trigger + dropdown
items.precondition: Signed in user with displayName and optional avatarUrl
steps: Observe profile trigger shows ProfileAvatar (~32px), not generic user icon
Choose Profile, then reopen menu and choose Switch mode, then Log out on a throwaway session
items.expected: Avatar reflects user photo or letter fallback; menu matches profile-dropdown polish; Profile navigates to /u/{username}; Switch mode toggles theme; Log out signs out.
items.evidence: User confirmed profile menu good; soft ring fix applied

items.title: Dark mode parity
steps: Toggle dark mode via profile menu Switch mode
Inspect header shadow, pill track, icons, avatar ring, dropdown
items.expected: All navbar surfaces use dark tokens; contrast remains readable; no hard-coded light-only backgrounds.
items.evidence: CSS uses var(--*) tokens throughout .app-navbar-*; dark :root overrides apply
items.notes: Manual dark toggle not re-run this session

items.title: Signed-out header
steps: Observe header right cluster and brand
items.expected: Brand wordmark matches signed-in polish; ThemeToggle + Sign in still present and functional; no profile avatar/menu.
items.evidence: AppNavbar signed-out branch unchanged (ThemeToggle + Sign in); shared header shell

items.title: Narrow viewport
steps: Verify three zones remain usable without horizontal scroll
items.expected: No hamburger added; pill cluster and icons remain tappable; brand truncates gracefully if needed.
items.evidence: Grid layout preserved; icon-only pills; brand truncate class retained
items.notes: 375px spot-check deferred; layout constraints unchanged from Plan 19
